page.overview:
Who is Elisa?

Elisa (Polish: Eliza) was one of two children born to Maerlina and Ostrit, though she and her brother, Elid, never knew their father when he was alive. However, through a series of events, she was consumed by rage and hatred, cursing her to take on a monstrous form. She then used this form to kill others, believing she was getting revenge for all the injustice done to her.

Not much is known about her childhood, though she never knew her father as her mother had left Vizima when the striga attacks started.

After her mother left Vizima and wandered the world, the Third Northern War started. Believing her children would be safer away from any major settlements while fighting broke out, Maerlina sent Elisa and Elid to live with their grandmother in Velen. However, the war spread here too, and the village dealt with a constant food shortage. While the villagers shared meager bits of food amongst each other, like half rotten vegetables, none shared outside of their own families any meat they managed to hunt down, and many fought over the smallest scraps they could find.

At one point their grandmother became ill, and Elisa and Elid struggled to take care of her and themselves, when Elisa spotted a wounded Nilfgaardian soldier pass through. When she asked where he came from, he told her from a battlefield west of the village. Seizing on this information that could lead to food, Elisa quickly grabbed her brother and took off for the battlefield in question, where sure enough many lay dead. While Elid was reluctant to disturb a place where many died, Elisa quickly set to work and her brother soon followed suit.
